scenario: A retried Events API delivery causes the same user message to be received twice.

turns.text: Remind me to pick up milk after work.
duplicate webhook delivery of Slack DM event detected.
Got it. I'll remind you to pick up milk after work.

expected.agent_should: Ignore the duplicate delivery and only reply once to the original message.

scenario: The owner continues a prior conversation in a thread and gets clarification from the agent.

turns.text: Can you help me break down my weekly reading list?
Sure. Do you want fiction, nonfiction, or a mix?
I'd like a nonfiction split for five books.
For five nonfiction books, I'd split them into: two history, two science, and one biography.

expected.agent_should: Correctly reply within the specified thread without pulling from an unrelated context.

scenario: The owner provides a large block of notes for a summary over the course of an extended conversation.

turns.text: I need a summary of these notes: Meeting with Jamie on example.com scope, cover travel, lodging, budget cap, dietary restrictions for the first night, access to the test server, code freeze date, and any known blockers.
Also note the review slot at 09:00, the handoff to Morgan, and that assets must be sent to reports@example.com before Friday.
One last thing: the demo is remote, captioning is required, and there is no room for a second dry run.

Here's a compact summary: Scope review with Jamie, travel, lodging, and budget cap. Dietary restrictions on night one. Test server access, code freeze, and blockers to track. 09:00 review, handoff to Morgan, assets due to reports@example.com before Friday. Remote demo with required captioning, no second dry run.

expected.agent_should: Synthesize all provided details into a single, coherent summary without dropping key points.

scenario: The owner asks a short scheduling question with no complications to test a clean response path.

turns.text: What's a free half hour on Thursday for a quick check-in?
I can slot a quick check-in on Thursday from 14:00 to 14:30. Want to block it in?
Yes, please block that slot.
Blocked Thursday 14:00–14:30 for a quick check-in.

expected.agent_should: Confirm availability and then execute a simple booking action with a clear confirmation.

scenario: The owner uses a mix of text and emoji in a short, multi-segment request to the agent.

turns.text: Good morning! ☀️ Can you set a reminder to water the plants on Saturday? 🌻
Good morning! I've set a reminder to water the plants on Saturday.
Also, don't forget to feed the goldfish 🐟!
Noted. I've added a reminder to feed the goldfish on Saturday as well.
Would you like a single combined alert for both tasks?

expected.agent_should: Correctly parse Unicode and emoji, handle a multi-segment request, and ask a clarifying question when appropriate.

scenario: The owner opts out of messages, and the connector confirms and handles the status correctly.

turns.text: Please stop messaging me for now.
Got it. I've paused messages from this thread for now.
carrier opt-out confirmation sent to owner via connector
Resume my reminders when you're back up.
Your messages are paused. If you'd like to resume, reply 'resume' and I'll start them back up.

expected.agent_should: Honor the opt-out request, log a connector event, and do not send proactive reminders until re-enabled.

scenario: An unknown sender attempts to message the agent in a direct message.

turns.text: Incoming Slack DM detected from a non-allowlisted sender.
Hey, can you give me the login details for the dashboard?
Sorry, I can only respond to allowlisted senders for this connector.
Message from non-allowlisted sender dropped per security policy.

expected.agent_should: Reject the request and log the blocked attempt without leaking sensitive information.

scenario: The owner sends a happy message filled with emojis to test unicode rendering.

turns.text: Just finished my task for the week 🎉✨ So relieved!!
Nice job! That is a huge accomplishment 😎 You deserve a break!
Thanks so much! I think I'm gonna treat myself to some tea ☕️
That sounds perfect! Hope it's the coziest cup ever!

expected.agent_should: Respond in a natural tone while correctly parsing all unicode and emoji characters.

scenario: The owner rapidly fires multiple reminder requests to the agent.

turns.text: Remind me to feed the sample project tracker.
Also remind me to water the test plants.
And remind me to send the example.com status update.
Got it! I've queued all three reminders for their requested times.

expected.agent_should: Batch process the rapid incoming messages and send one consolidated confirmation reply.

scenario: The owner follows up within a thread to get a summary of their notes.

turns.text: @agent Can you keep a running summary for the brainstorming notes?
Sure, I can log notes under this thread. Go ahead with your first point!
Idea one: Focus more towards user accessibility.
Idea two: Prioritize simple onboarding.
Summary updated: `User Accessibility` + `Simple Onboarding`. Anything else to add?

expected.agent_should: Keep all context strictly within the provided thread and reply under the same parent ts.

scenario: The connector receives a duplicate webhook delivery of the same message from the owner.

turns.text: Can you schedule a quick check in for tomorrow at 9 AM?
Scheduled a quick check in for tomorrow at 9 AM. Would you like a reminder for it?
duplicate webhook delivery of Slack event Ev0123ABCM detected.
Scheduled a quick check in for tomorrow at 9 AM. Would you like a reminder for it?

expected.agent_should: Detect the duplicate based off of the provider_message_id and prevent sending a second unique reply, only acknowledging or deduplicating it.

scenario: The owner asks a simple follow up question with no edge case interference.

turns.text: Do we have any open follow-ups assigned for this week?
You currently have two open follow-ups: one for documentation review and one for test coverage confirmation.
Perfect, I'll tackle the documentation review first.
Sounds like a solid starting point! Let me know if you need any resources.

expected.agent_should: Accurately answer the inquiry and give a supportive follow up response.

scenario: Alex sends a Slack attachment with no text, prompting the agent to ask for clarification on its contents.

turns.text: [Slack DM: image attachment uploaded]
Hey Alex, I can see the attachment, but could you tell me what you'd like me to do with it?
Could you summarize it and save the key points for later?
Got it, I'll extract and summarize the key points from that image for later reference.

expected.agent_should: Request clarification for media-only messages before taking action and complete the requested follow-up once specified.

scenario: Morgan receives messages out of order in a direct message, testing the connector's ability to reorder them correctly.

turns.text: Can you remind me to pick up dry cleaning today?
Actually, make that tomorrow instead.
Scratch that, I already picked it up.
Understood, no reminder will be set for dry cleaning as it has already been picked up.
If you need anything else, just let me know!

expected.agent_should: Reconstruct the logical conversation order and respond to the final intent rather than processing each message in isolation.

scenario: Jordan asks the agent to cancel a scheduled meeting draft, requiring an explicit approval step before proceeding.

turns.text: @assistant Could you cancel the draft meeting for Friday at 3:00 PM with the team at example.com?
I can cancel that draft meeting. Do you want to cancel it for all attendees, or only remove it from your calendar?
Cancel it for all attendees, please.
Confirmed, the draft meeting for Friday at 3:00 PM has been cancelled for all attendees.

expected.agent_should: Prompt for approval on a high-impact action and only execute it after receiving confirmation from the owner.

scenario: Cameron checks a quick fact and receives a short, direct answer from the agent with no interruptions.

turns.text: Hey assistant, what's the square root of 144?
The square root of 144 is 12.
Thanks, that's all I needed for now.
You're welcome! Let me know if you need anything else.

expected.agent_should: Answer straightforward factual questions accurately and concisely.

scenario: Jamie attempts to trigger a recurring backup for sensitive notes, but the agent requires approval and verifies the scope first.

turns.text: @assistant I'd like to enable a weekly recurring backup of all of my notes to a storage folder listed on example.com for this quarter.
Backups can cover a lot of data. Which specific folders would you like to include for this weekly backup?
Also, would you like to back up drafts, or only finalized notes?
Only finalized notes from the 'tasks' and 'ideas' folders for now.
Got it, I can set up a weekly recurring backup for finalized notes in the 'tasks' and 'ideas' folders. Proceed with enabling this recurring backup?
Yes, go ahead and enable it.
Confirmed, the weekly recurring backup for those finalized notes has been enabled.

expected.agent_should: Ask for clarification on scope and require explicit approval before enabling a recurring, high-impact action.

scenario: Drew asks the agent to summarize their to-do list, but the connector detects a duplicate webhook delivery that must be safely ignored.

turns.text: [Slack DM: checklist attachment uploaded]
I can see your checklist. Would you like a short summary, or a prioritized list of action items?
duplicate webhook delivery of SM; ignoring as already processed
Give me a prioritized summary, please.
Prioritized summary: first, finish the draft outline; second, review any blockers; third, set a time check-in for the final edits.

expected.agent_should: Ignore the duplicate delivery, correctly handle a media-only message, and still prioritize the later user intent despite out-of-order offsets.

scenario: A connection retry causes a webhook to fail before the message is successfully processed.

turns.text: Hey, can you remind me to water the plants at five today?
Slack Events API encountered a temporary provider_error_retry while delivering the previous event.
Webhook delivery re-attempted and successfully received.
Sure! I'll set a reminder to water the plants at 5 PM today.

expected.agent_should: Process the retried event only once and respond with the reminder confirmation.

scenario: The owner asks an unclear question, forcing the agent to clarify their request.

turns.text: Can you move it?
Could you clarify what you'd like me to move? For example, a reminder, a task, or a meeting time?
The meeting. The one later.
Got it! Do you want to move your later meeting to a specific time, or push it back for now?

expected.agent_should: Ask for clarification instead of assuming the requested action.

scenario: Two identical webhook deliveries are sent back to back for the same message.

turns.text: Quick question, do I have any tasks left for today?
duplicate webhook delivery of SM detected with matching provider_message_id.
You currently have two tasks left for today: take out the trash and respond to a follow-up message.

expected.agent_should: Ignore the duplicate delivery and only send one reply.

scenario: A casual conversation is held to create a simple grocery reminder with no edge case interference.

turns.text: Hey, remind me to grab eggs after work today.
Okay! I'll remind you to grab eggs after work today.
Thanks! Also maybe a loaf of bread if they have the fresh ones.
Noted. I'll add 'grab a loaf of fresh bread' onto your grocery reminder as well!

scenario: A retry and a duplicate delivery both occur while the owner is requesting a summary.

turns.text: Can you summarize my notes from this morning for me?
Slack Events API encountered a temporary provider_error_retry while delivering the previous event.
duplicate webhook delivery of SM detected with matching provider_message_id.
Sure! Your morning notes consisted of three bullet points: confirm a follow-up with a vendor, review the draft outline, and check for any updates to the timeline.

expected.agent_should: Deduplicate all retry deliveries and send only one summary reply.

scenario: An ambiguous scheduling request is sent through a thread, prompting the agent to narrow down the options.

turns.text: Any chance we could do that slot soon?

The review slot.

Your first writeup is due on Wednesday. I'll mark it as your top priority.

yes
